day: # The Coptic Orthodox Church's lectionary (the Katameros): for each day the
# Vespers and Matins psalm and Gospel (with the Matins prophecies of Lent and
# Holy Week), and the Liturgy's Pauline Epistle, Catholic Epistle, Acts
# (Praxis), psalm and Gospel; the hours of Pascha in Holy Week.
# From the katameros-api database and its rules (MIT License, (c) 2022
# the lectionary of katameros.app, after St-Takla.org's), citations in the
# English (NKJV) numbering.  Its rules, kept here by the `when` column:
#   * The Annual readings by Coptic date on weekdays; the Sunday readings by
#     the Coptic month and the Sunday of it; Great Lent's own (from the Monday
#     55 days before Easter to the Friday before Lazarus Saturday) and the
#     Fifty Days' own (Easter to Pentecost) instead, and the feasts below
#   * A Sunday on the 29th of a month (not Koiak, Tobi or Meshir) reads the
#   * The Nativity on 7 January; its Paramoun (28 Koiak's readings) on 6
#     January, and on the 4th and 5th too when the 6th is a Sunday (the 5th
#     when a Saturday).  When 6 January is a Sunday, Koiak's Sundays begin on
#     the last Sunday of Hathor.  A Sunday on 30 Koiak, and 29 Koiak when it is
#     8 January, keep the day's Annual readings.
#   * Theophany (11 Tobi, the day's readings) and its Paramoun (10 Tobi, and
#     the Friday, or Friday and Saturday, before when Theophany is a Sunday or
#     Monday); the Wedding at Cana (13 Tobi); Nayrouz (1 Thout); the Cross (17
#     to 19 Thout, 10 Paremhat); the Entrance into the Temple (8 Meshir); the
#     Annunciation (29 Paremhat); the Entrance into Egypt (24 Pashons) -- not
#     in the week before Easter, nor on Thomas Sunday, Ascension Day or
#     Pentecost, which keep the Fifty Days' readings.
#   * The Fast of Nineveh and Jonah's feast, the Saturday and Sunday before
#     Great Lent, Lazarus Saturday, Palm Sunday, the days of Pascha and Easter
#     by Easter; the Entrance into the Temple before them on the same day.
